text:
I couldn't find a lunch set menu price for either place, so I can't say they're near £30 a head. Brother Marcus Soho's private room lists a £350–£588 minimum spend on weekdays. That's about £35–£59 a head for 10, though the listing may be out of date. For OKA Kingly Court I found only a general £26–£40 restaurant band. Rebecca will need to ask both on Monday.
